children: Nordic markets are seen opening slightly higher with IG calling the OMXS30 up 0.1% at around 3295. Stock markets in Europe rose slightly yesterday while U.S. markets were closed for Labor Day, SEB economist Pia Fromlet writes. Oil prices continue to rise, with Brent approaching $100 a barrel on renewed supply concerns following the latest attacks between the U.S. and Iran, Fromlet says. Meanwhile, the price of copper yesterday hit a record $14,530 per ton. Stock markets in Asia are mixed and futures are pointing higher in Europe and the U.S. Today, Canada's tariffs on goods from the U.S. equivalent to $20 billion will come into effect. OMXS30 closed at 3291.84, OMXN40 at 2710.84 and OBX at 2014.28. (dominic.chopping@wsj.com)
